}}'''Daricain Annallin''' is from the [[Cairhienin]] [[House Annallin]]. 

==Appearance==
He is a pale, slender man with a narrow face and long nose and has the shaved head of a Cairhienin soldier.

==History==
He is a lieutenant. His ''[[con]]'' has red and black squares all over it. 

==Activities==
[[File:Daricain Annallein con.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Daricain Annallin's ''con'']]
He is sent from Cairhien when it is attacked by the [[Shaido]] and finds [[Rand al'Thor]] and the rest of the [[Aiel]].
